newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says to make 6,000-7,000 C70 '97.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says to make 6,000-7,000 C70 '97.

text.p: Volvo Cars, a unit of Swedish automotive group AB Volvo, said on Monday it would start manufacturing its new model C70 shortly and it expected to make between 6,000 and 7,000 such cars this year.

"Production of the series C70 will start in a short time and the sales' start will be in June/July on chosen markets," Ulf Thorne, spokesman at Volvo Cars, told Reuters. "This year we expect to produce between 6,000 and 7,000 C70."
The U.S., Germany, Japan, Italy and Britain will be among the chosen markets, he said.
The first test run with people from the media is currently taking place in California, the U.S.
"We expect about 50 percent of the model's total volume to be sold in the U.S.," Thorne said.
